learning_outcomes.text: Ability to define vector problems in Cartesian, cylindrical and spherical coordinates. Ability to convert between coordinate systems.
Ability to use vector operators and solve vector problems.
Ability to perform operations with complex numbers.
Ability to perform Laplace and inverse Laplace transforms.

syllabus_topics: Scalar and vector quantities, concepts of scalar and vector fields, vector arithmetic. Unit vector and position vector
Orthogonal coordinate systems; Cartesian, cylindrical coordinate systems and point and vector transformations in these systems
Spherical coordinate system, point and vector representations in this system, and spherical-cylindrical, spherical-Cartesian point and vector transformations
Exact differentials and vector derivatives, Nabla operator, and the concept of gradient and Laplacian
Vector derivatives; divergence of a vector field
Vector derivatives; curl of a vector field
Line, surface, and volume integrals for vector fields
Line, surface, and volume integrals for vector fields
Complex numbers and the complex plane
bibliography: F. Birbir Ünal, O. Demiryürek, Ders Notu
M. R. Spiegel, Vector analysis, Schaum Outline series, 2019.
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
